rationale:
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Updated C# code to use the renamed field DisplayName (from Name) for the v1 Entity message. This matches the proto schema change where field 'name' was renamed to 'display_name' on the same wire field 2. Both the field extraction in ProcessEntity and the entity construction for --serve mode now use the new property name. The v2 Entity is unchanged as it doesn't have this field.
runtimes/python/main.py: Both candidate lines access the renamed field 'name' on v1 Entity objects. After the schema change, the Python binding will expose 'display_name' instead. Line 33 reads the field for observation output, and line 117 writes it for test entity creation. Both must be updated to use 'display_name' to match the regenerated bindings.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: The TypeScript bindings for v1 Entity will regenerate with 'displayName' (camelCase) replacing 'name' on the same wire field 2. Line 13 reads the field for logging and must use the new property name. Line 83 constructs a test message and must use the new property name in the encode call. Both changes preserve all values and behavior.
assumptions: runtimes/csharp/main.cs: Protobuf C# code generation uses PascalCase for property names (display_name -> DisplayName)
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: The regenerated bindings for v1 will have DisplayName property instead of Name
runtimes/csharp/main.cs: v2 Entity schema is unchanged and doesn't have a name/display_name field
runtimes/python/main.py: Protobuf Python bindings use snake_case field names directly as attributes
runtimes/python/main.py: The field number (2) remains unchanged so wire compatibility is preserved
runtimes/python/main.py: v2 Entity schema is unaffected by this change
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: The protobuf TypeScript generator uses camelCase for field names (display_name -> displayName).
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: The generated EntityV1 class will have a 'displayName' property and no 'name' property after regeneration.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: Wire format is unchanged (field 2 remains field 2), so decoding existing v1 messages works automatically.
runtimes/typescript/main.ts: No other files need updates; the prompt specifies not to edit test sources, and line 83 is main runtime code (under --serve/--v1 flag) not a test file.
